snippet.title: Johan - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4167150/Johan/

Ever wondered what the story was behind those killer medieval rabbits? I did too, so I'm making a game about it. This is a solo-developed project I started a year ago, combining the things I love: Fromsoftware games, medieval art and well crafted animations! Stay tuned for more news.

About Johan:
Play as a Johan, a rabbit born straight out of a medieval manuscript out for revenge against the armies of knights that ravage the land. Though your foes are bigger than you, use your deadly swordplay and the power of illuminated manuscripts to take them all down in this intense, combat-driven adventure!

Credits: 
Sound design: Stanislas d'Arnoux de Fleury https://sdarnouxdefleury.com/ 
Music: Matteo Barrault

#indiegame #medieval #rabbit #gamedev #trailer
